status: Complete interface reviews; implementation transfer opportunities remain

insights.evidence: InstructionSimplify returns constants or existing def-reachable dominating values; it does not create instructions.
insights.transfer: Rank checked existing-subterm or constant replacements as a bounded cheap search tier; investigate current candidate scheduler before implementation. This does not permit bypassing Ink equality proofs.

insights.evidence: SimplifyQuery carries DataLayout, target library, dominance, assumptions, instruction/function, dominating conditions and local condition context; copy helpers add/remove contexts.
insights.transfer: Ink branch-local facts already use explicit scope. Any shared memoization must bind source, scope and semantics rather than source alone. No shared memo cache introduced in current change.

insights.evidence: InstrInfoQuery conservatively hides metadata, nowrap, exact and no-signed-zero properties when UseInstrInfo=false.
insights.transfer: Never import flags as assumptions just because an optimizer emitted them. Existing LLVM learner proposals require independent Ink equality replay; additional importer audit remains.

insights.evidence: CanUseUndef, AllowRefinement and DropFlags explicitly distinguish refinement from identical values; replacing all undef uses avoids inconsistent resolutions.
insights.transfer: Ink deterministic values/errors require its own admitted equality domain. LLVM undef/poison refinements cannot be copied as law authority.

insights.evidence: simplifyConstrainedFPCall explicitly guarantees successful simplification removes side effects; ordinary simplification does not imply that contract.
insights.transfer: Future readonly/fallible/effectful call simplification must prove preserved errors/events/state in addition to value. Current word-fact producer remains scalar equality proposals.

insights.evidence: Rounding and exception behavior are explicit; simplifyFMAFMul preserves unrounded distinctions needed by FMA.
insights.transfer: Preserve Ink exact F32 semantics. Do not infer multiply/add fusion from equal individually rounded products.

insights.evidence: replaceAndRecursivelySimplify visits changed users and returns unsimplified users; CondContext records affected values.
insights.transfer: Potential bounded incremental proposal regeneration keyed by changed ancestors/dependencies. Needs planner graph audit and before/after measurements; not implemented here.

insights.evidence: getBestSimplifyQuery helpers choose currently valid optional analyses; query helpers remove condition caches.
insights.transfer: Source-bound facts and cache invalidation should remain explicit across transformations; published corpus capture binds consumed source. Broad invalidation audit remains.

limitations: This evidence covers declarations and contracts in two headers, not their full implementation or all LLVM optimization behavior.
No performance measurement or new optimization claim follows from this review.
